name: causal-TWAS (cTWAS)
model_likelihood: Gaussian regression of phenotype on imputed expression and variant genotypes
prior: Gene- and variant-group spike-and-slab priors with learned inclusion probabilities and Gaussian slab variances
inference_algorithm: Empirical-Bayes EM with blockwise single-effect posterior approximation, followed by SuSiE fine-mapping
estimand: Gene and variant posterior inclusion probabilities
data_input: Individual-level trait, genotypes and pretrained expression predictions; alternatively variant GWAS estimates and standard errors plus LD and prediction weights
tunable_settings: SuSiE effect count L (5 in reported final inference); EM iteration limit and tolerance; single-effect block selection threshold; variant thinning fraction; PIP reporting and refinement thresholds
